title: Closure points of an intersection of constructible sets in a spectral space are specializations
statement: Let $X$ be a spectral space [def-weil-spectral-space], let $(E_a)_{a\in A}$ be a family of constructible subsets of $X$ [def-weil-constructible-subset], and let $E=\bigcap_{a\in A}E_a$ (with $E=X$ if $A=\emptyset$). If $x\in X$ lies in the closure $\overline{E}$ of $E$, then there is a point $e\in E$ with $x\in\overline{\{e\}}$, i.e. $x$ is a specialization of a point of $E$.
